Which plugin base-class method declares the hook, which plugin base-class method applies the state filter and calls it, which orchestrator method walks all plugins (an exception of one plugin must not stop its neighbours), and which process-module method must register this notification among the stop-time work entries?

The program thread must report a distinct outcome for transport errors (but not for errors reported by the robot or for compile errors), and the park state machine must map that outcome to the link-lost text.
